comment: The Macro Editor's optimizer rules (spec ME10). Only automatic rules are applied; each reason says why the rewrite is the same in game.

target_to_at.title: target= to @
target_to_at.reason: target= is the older spelling of @: both pick the unit the command acts on.

duplicate_conditions.title: Drop a repeated conditional
duplicate_conditions.reason: Conditionals inside one [] must all be true, so the same one twice adds nothing.

strip_spaces.title: Drop spaces the parser ignores
strip_spaces.reason: Spaces inside [], between [] blocks and after ; are ignored when the macro runs (the wiki's own `[@mouseover, help] [ ] Flash of Light` works as written).

showtooltip_same.title: #showtooltip without its spell
showtooltip_same.reason: With no spell named, #showtooltip shows the macro's first spell, and that is the spell it named.

cast_to_use.title: /cast to /use (never applied)
cast_to_use.reason: Not the same in every case: when a name is both a spell and an item, /cast picks the spell and /use the item, so the optimizer never swaps them.
